guarantees.optimization: Bounded-TTL AttrTimeout cache with immediate local-mutation and Head-generation invalidation
guarantees.previous_guarantee: Cross-writer inode attribute freshness (size, mtime, mode, nlink) at single-syscall granularity.
guarantees.preserved_guarantee: 100% read-your-own-writes consistency via synchronous invalidation on Write/SetAttr/Create/Mkdir/Remove/Flush and fenced-Head generation bumps; cross-writer staleness strictly bounded to AttrTimeout.
guarantees.negative_regime: External concurrent writer mutating attributes faster than AttrTimeout observes stale cached metadata until TTL expiry or Head generation bump.
guarantees.safety_invariant: Local mutations synchronously evict affected inode attr before returning; expired entries are never served.

guarantees.optimization: Bounded-TTL EntryTimeout cache for (parentIno, name) -> Inode with immediate local-mutation invalidation
guarantees.previous_guarantee: Immediate visibility of external directory entry creation, unlink, or rename on every path component walk.
guarantees.preserved_guarantee: 100% local namespace coherence via synchronous invalidation on Create/Mkdir/Remove/Rename and fenced-Head generation bumps; cross-writer staleness strictly bounded to EntryTimeout.
guarantees.negative_regime: External writer creating or unlinking names faster than EntryTimeout sees stale positive entries until TTL expiry or Head generation bump.
guarantees.safety_invariant: Local Create/Mkdir/Remove synchronously invalidate (parent, name) and parent dir entries before returning.

guarantees.optimization: Bounded-TTL DirCache caching directory entries and parent inode together
guarantees.previous_guarantee: Immediate visibility of external directory membership updates on every readdir + parent lookup.
guarantees.preserved_guarantee: 100% local directory listing coherence via immediate invalidation on any child mutation in dir and on fenced-Head generation bumps; cross-writer staleness strictly bounded to DirCacheTTL.
guarantees.negative_regime: Externally churned directories within DirCacheTTL return stale child sets until TTL expiry or invalidation.
guarantees.safety_invariant: Any local Create/Mkdir/Remove under dir synchronously evicts DirCache[dir].

guarantees.optimization: SkipRedundantOpenStat using cached immutable inode type (regular vs directory) prior to vol.Open
guarantees.previous_guarantee: None beyond AttrTimeout: pkg/mount/fuse_unix.go calls vol.Stat solely to check in.IsDir(), but an allocated inode ID never changes file type in place.
guarantees.preserved_guarantee: No guarantee weakened: directory inodes are still rejected/handled as directories, and cache misses or unlinked inodes fall back directly to vol.Stat and vol.Open.
guarantees.negative_regime: None on valid POSIX volumes; cold cache falls back cleanly to vol.Stat.
guarantees.safety_invariant: An inode ID's file type bit (ModeDir vs regular) is immutable for its lifetime; unlinked inodes still return fs.ErrNotExist from vol.Open.

guarantees.optimization: EnableHeadVersionCache tracking the last observed backend.Version (ETag) for fenced Head conditional writes
guarantees.previous_guarantee: Precondition ETag acquisition for server-side compare-and-set (PutIfVersion / S3 If-Match) prior to committing fenced Head.
guarantees.preserved_guarantee: 100% CAS authority and fenced-Head monotonicity preserved: every conditional write still executes server-side PutIfVersion(key, data, cachedVersion); any backend.ErrConflict immediately invalidates the cache and retries against an authoritative Get + round check.
guarantees.negative_regime: Continuous multi-writer CAS contention causes optimistic cached PutIfVersion to fail with ErrConflict, adding a failed conditional PUT round-trip before authoritative Get+retry.
guarantees.safety_invariant: OptimizedBackend never converts PutIfVersion into unconditional Put and never bypasses fence.ErrStaleRound.

guarantees.optimization: Opt-in bounded-TTL HeadCacheTTL read-through (default 0 = strict linearizable reads)
guarantees.previous_guarantee: Linearizable observation of the latest externally committed Head by independent readers (Volume.Open, fence.Store.Round).
guarantees.preserved_guarantee: With HeadCacheTTL == 0 (default), linearizability is 100% unchanged. With HeadCacheTTL > 0, staleness is bounded by HeadCacheTTL and immediately invalidated on local writes or ErrConflict.
guarantees.negative_regime: External Head commits or round takeovers within HeadCacheTTL are hidden from read-only callers until TTL expiry or conflict invalidation.
guarantees.safety_invariant: Any local PutIfVersion, PutIfAbsent, Delete, or ErrConflict synchronously invalidates cached Head payload and bumps generation.

guarantees.optimization: EnableShardCache bounded LRU for immutable content-addressed meta/<2hex>/<blake3hex> shards and immutable Stat
guarantees.previous_guarantee: None: meta/ shards are content-addressed by the BLAKE3 digest of their sealed bytes (SPECIFICATION 3) and immutable once written.
guarantees.preserved_guarantee: 100% content integrity preserved: every cached meta/ shard is verified against blake3.Sum(data) == keyDigest before insertion; tampered backend responses fail closed and are never cached.
guarantees.negative_regime: One-shot cold scans larger than MaxShardCacheBytes incur bounded LRU eviction overhead with 0% reuse (no correctness loss).
guarantees.safety_invariant: Only immutable digest-verified meta/<2hex>/<64hex> objects enter ShardCache; returned slices are defensive copies.

guarantees.optimization: Bounded-TTL ListCacheTTL prefix listing cache with immediate local mutation invalidation
guarantees.previous_guarantee: Point-in-time visibility of objects added or deleted externally under the listed prefix.
guarantees.preserved_guarantee: 100% local write visibility via immediate invalidation of any cached prefix matching local Put/PutIfAbsent/PutIfVersion/Delete; external staleness strictly bounded to ListCacheTTL.
guarantees.negative_regime: External writers or garbage collectors modifying objects under the prefix within ListCacheTTL observe stale listings until expiry.
guarantees.safety_invariant: Any mutating backend call synchronously evicts every cached prefix that is a prefix of the mutated key.

guarantees.optimization: EnableRangeCoalescing merging contiguous/near-contiguous GetRange spans on immutable pack/ objects within MaxCoalesceGap and MaxCoalesceWindow
guarantees.previous_guarantee: None for immutable pack/ objects: packs are write-once sealed chunk containers and every chunk is still individually authenticated against its chunkID and chunkAAD.
guarantees.preserved_guarantee: 100% chunk integrity and backend.Backend.GetRange EOF contract preserved: arithmetic is overflow-checked and sequential read-ahead is clamped to exact known pack size so reads never cross EOF.
guarantees.negative_regime: Purely random sparse chunk reads suffer read amplification if non-adaptive read-ahead is forced; adaptive adjacency gating avoids unnecessary prefetch on random access.
guarantees.safety_invariant: All range offsets/lengths are validated against negative values and int64 overflow; returned byte slices match exact uncoalesced GetRange output byte-for-byte.
